scientific_integrity: Theorem proved only for centered disagreement in the neutral-utility always-active stochastic pairwise model, with Gaussian shocks on selected agents. Historical priority has not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Uncentered mean has no stationary law; no finite confidence or nonconstant-utility conclusion; explicit marginal kurtosis formula restricted to three agents.
title: The first non-Gaussian noisy-compromise population and its exact fourth moment
